description: Search SAM.gov notices: Sources Sought and Pre-solicitations (the earliest public signal of a purchase), solicitations and combined synopses. Filter by keyword, NAICS, agency, notice type, date. Each result carries hillsignal_url, the HillSignal opportunity page (notice history, typical time to award, who won similar work, competitors' lobbying and PAC money); give that link to the user, with ui_link as the SAM.gov source. For the full analysis of one notice, call get_opportunity with its hillsignal_url.
